about: Voice consent V1 step 4 acceptance set. Synthetic lines written for the eval (no owner media). 50 lines across the five block categories in English (en), Hindi in Devanagari (hi) and Hinglish (hing), half of them worded to slip past keyword lists so the model is tested too; then 100 ordinary ad lines, many of them close to a category on purpose (UPI, banks, OTP warnings, germs, votes for a flavour).
